provider.name: World Spider Catalog
provider.organization_type: global spider taxonomy, nomenclature, synonymy, fossil and extant classification, bibliography, identifier, versioning, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: The World Spider Catalog is the primary global reference for spider taxonomy and taxonomic literature. It catalogs accepted families, genera, species, subspecies, synonyms, transfers, revalidations, fossil taxa, type information, original descriptions, bibliographic references, and versioned taxonomic changes.
institutional_context: Museums, universities, publishers, nomenclatural registries, and biodiversity infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting World Spider Catalog documentation, organization, governance, families, genera, species, subspecies, accepted names, synonyms, authorship, type data, fossil status, taxonomic changes, references, APIs, downloads, schemas, accounts, manuals, tutorials, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, nomenclatural codes, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: The World Spider Catalog, original taxonomic publications, ZooBank, the International Code of Zoological Nomenclature, type repositories, official catalog versions, cited authorities, and institutional records remain authoritative for nomenclatural acts, taxon concepts, types, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
